jobs.prompt: The same bright, orderly contemporary Italian pharmacy during normal business. Camera almost still with a very slight natural drift. The owner behind the counter keeps serving the elderly customer and hands her the small box; midway he lifts his eyes and briefly notices the man in the dark suit waiting near the entrance, a slight controlled tightening of the lips, then turns back to his customer with professional composure. The man with the briefcase stays where he is and waits politely, shifting his weight once; he does not walk forward and does not approach the counter. The female pharmacist and the customer in the queue glance toward him once, discreetly, then return to what they were doing. Small, realistic, unhurried movements. No dramatic entrance, no thriller tension, no fear, no caricature, 13 seconds.
must_show: titolare occupato al banco che percepisce il visitatore
visitatore con valigetta che attende educatamente
staff/cliente che lo notano con discrezione

jobs.prompt: The owner in his small back office reads a message on his own phone held at chest height, the screen always facing him and never visible to the camera. No floating interface, no graphics or animations, no screen content, nobody else enters, 5 seconds.
